description: Audit of fz-9i4.7.5 found that non-.value resource dot access is rejected, but native/AOT abort via runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs expect("fz_struct_get_named_field_ref") while backend interp returns a clean error. Acceptance: h.foo on a resource fails consistently with a controlled diagnostic/runtime error on run/interp/build and does not expose payloads; resource .value remains the only payload path; cargo test --lib and clippy pass.
title: Native resource non-value field access reports a controlled error instead of aborting
